question: When is the installation of the womb chamber considered most excellent relative to deity installation?
premises: The verse compares timing of two installations.
The installation of the deity is the reference point.
Performing the other installation before it is evaluated as best.
inference: Installation before the installation of the deity would be the best.
uncertainties: The subject sthāpanaṃ likely refers to the womb-chamber installation from the previous verse.
plain_english: And installation before the installation of the deity would be the best.
